meta.name: Songhealth CMS Content Model
meta.description: Feature 002 seed intent for the existing canonical platform: defines the shared native documents collection (required title and native file selection, optional domain metadata and the document_successor self-relation), the native pages collection for general information (required title, optional summary and portable-text body, no conditional media fields yet) bound to the optional page_documents relation (Page parent → Document, many-to-many) and the shared native taxonomies — topic, audience and hierarchical area — plus the Document-only document_type classification, with topic and document_type attached to documents; audience and area still await their owning collections. Still defines zero menus, redirects, widgetAreas, sections and content, suppressing EmDash's built-in example Posts/Pages model. Term inventories are intentionally empty pending authoritative sources; no official terms, geographic codes or inventories are supplied. Taxonomy attachments are added as each owning collection is introduced. Area terms model the applicable Province → District → Subdistrict → Village hierarchy: explicit official/stable code in the native term slug, name in the native label, parent via native group identity.
